a butterfly valve disc assembly as three solids: a 100mm diameter disc with a 12.1mm cross-bore, a 12mm diameter shaft 140mm long passing through the disc bore, and a 4mm diameter retaining pin 20mm long fitted through aligned cross-holes in the disc and shaft with running clearance to prevent relative rotation

a D-shackle as two solids: a forged shackle body with a 40mm internal width and two 16.1mm through-holes in its ears, and a 16mm diameter shackle pin 70mm long with a screwed collar head, fitted through the ears with running clearance

a folding leg hinge as four solids: a fixed leaf bracket with a 10.1mm knuckle bore, a folding leg bracket with a matching 10.1mm knuckle bore offset to interleave with it, a 10mm diameter hinge pin 45mm long fitted through both knuckles with running clearance, and a 6mm diameter spring-loaded locking pin 20mm long that engages a detent hole when the leg is extended

a weather-vane pivot as three solids: a 12mm diameter vertical shaft 300mm long, a base bushing housing with a 12.1mm bore for running clearance, and a 4mm diameter transverse retaining pin 15mm long fitted through a cross-hole near the shaft's base to prevent it lifting out of the bushing

a dead-bolt lock mechanism as three solids: a 20mm square bolt throw 60mm long with a 6.1mm cam-slot hole, a lock case housing the throw with a matching guide channel, and a 6mm diameter actuator pin 25mm long fitted through the cam slot with running clearance to translate rotary motion into linear bolt travel

a two-bar door check linkage as three solids: a check arm 180mm long with a 9.1mm end bore, a stay bracket fixed to the door frame with a matching 9.1mm bore spaced 160mm away, and a 9mm diameter pivot pin 28mm long fitted with running clearance connecting the arm to the bracket

a lifting eye and shackle assembly as three solids: a forged lifting eye plate with a 20.1mm through-hole, a bow shackle body with two 20.1mm ear holes spaced 45mm apart, and a 20mm diameter shackle pin 80mm long fitted through both parts with running clearance

a rocker arm valve-train assembly as three solids: a 90mm long rocker arm with a 12.1mm centre pivot bore, a bronze pivot bushing with a 12.05mm bore pressed into the arm, and a 12mm diameter pivot shaft 60mm long fitted through the bushing with running clearance

an over-centre draw latch as four solids: a hook keeper fixed to the panel, a strike pin 8mm diameter mounted 40mm from the hinge line, a latch lever 100mm long with an 8.1mm slot to engage the strike pin, and an 8mm diameter pivot pin 25mm long joining the lever to its base bracket with running clearance

a landing-gear trunnion strut as three solids: a strut tube 220mm long with a 16.1mm cross-bore near its upper end, a fixed trunnion bracket with a matching 16.1mm bore, and a 16mm diameter trunnion pin 50mm long fitted through both with running clearance and phased so the strut swings freely about the bracket axis

a folding tripod leg hinge as three solids: a leg bracket with a 8.1mm knuckle bore, a central hub with three matching 8.1mm knuckle bores spaced 120 degrees apart, and an 8mm diameter hinge pin 35mm long fitted through each joint with running clearance

a chain tensioner arm as three solids: a pivoting arm 140mm long with a 10.1mm pivot bore at one end and a 30mm diameter idler wheel bore at the other, a fixed pivot bracket with a matching 10.1mm bore, and a 10mm diameter pivot pin 32mm long fitted with running clearance to allow the arm to sweep through 20 degrees

a garden shear pivot as three solids: two blade halves each with a 6.1mm pivot bore 20mm from the handle end, and a 6mm diameter pivot bolt shank 18mm long with a 10mm head, fitted through both bores with running clearance so the blades scissor about a common centre

a fold-down table bracket as four solids: a wall-mounted hinge plate with a 9.1mm knuckle bore, a table-side hinge plate with a matching 9.1mm bore offset to interleave, a 9mm diameter hinge pin 50mm long fitted with running clearance, and a fold-out support leg with an 6mm pivot pin 20mm long connecting it to a slotted bracket on the underside of the table
